tool.name: RECmd
tool.description: A command-line tool for parsing and analyzing Windows Registry hives.

features.name: Batch processing
features.description: Parses multiple Registry hives in a directory.

features.name: String search
features.description: Searches for specified strings within key names, value names, and data values.

features.name: Regular expression support
features.description: Supports regular expressions for more complex string searches.

features.name: Deleted key/value recovery
features.description: Attempts to recover deleted keys and values from the Registry hive.

features.name: Transaction log replaying
features.description: Replays transaction logs to ensure data integrity during parsing.

features.name: Dirty hive handling
features.description: Handles dirty hives by providing warnings and continuing processing.

examples.description: Parses a specified file for `URL` within the key names without recovering deleted keys/values and without replaying transaction logs.
Parses a specified file for specified regular expression within the value names.
